<entry id="P00793">
<head-word>עֲלִיבָא</head-word>
<head-word>עֲלוּ'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> = h. עָלוּב, 
<italic>humble, poor</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. XIV, 31 (h. text אביון).—Y. Taan. III, 66
<sup>c</sup> top ומה יעביד ע' what should the poor fellow do? Y. Kidd. III, 64
<sup>b</sup> top ולינאי ע' את וכ' and you consult poor Jannai (me) in matters of betrothal?—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲלִיבַיָּא, עֲלִיבֵי, עֲלוּ'</plural-form>. Targ. Prov. XXX, 14.—Lev. R. s. 32, end ואילין ע' מאי איכפת להון why should these luckless ones suffer (for their parents’ sins)?, v. אִכְפַּת. Yalk. Esth. 1056 בייא … בייא על עלו' woe to the king that brings woe upon the unfortunate!; a. e.—
<italic>Fem</italic>. (h. form) עֲלוּבָה; עֲלִיבְתָּא, עֲלוּ'. Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>b</sup>, v. אַכְסַנְיָא. Lev. R. s. 37, end; Koh. R. to X, 15, v. סוּף II ch.; Tanḥ. B’ḥuck. 5 עֲלִבְתָּא. Gen. R. s. 60, v. חַיְּיתָא II. Ib. s. 56 ברא דעלו', v. עָלוּב. Y. Shek. V, 48
<sup>d</sup> top הדא ע' this poor (animal). Lev. R. s. 5 ע' היא מדינתא וכ', v. דִּיאִיקִיטָא; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00794">
<head-word>עֲלִיָּה</head-word>
<head-word>עֲלִיָּיה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (עָלָה) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>upper chamber, upper story</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. X, 1 הבית והע' של שנים the house (lower compartment) and the upper story belonging severally to two persons. Ib. 2 הבית והע' נפחתה הע' (not של שנים) if there is a lower story (in which the owner lives) and an upper story (inhabited by a tenant), and the upper story is out of repair. Ib. 3. B. Bath. III, 7. Ned. VII, 4 הנודר מן הבית מותר בע' he who vows abstinence from ‘house’, is permitted to use an upper story (v. עִירוֹנִי). Sabb. I, 4 בעֲלִיַּית חנניה וכ' in the upper chamber of Ḥananiah &c. Keth. 50
<sup>b</sup> דברים טובים שנאמרו בע' the good things (in favor of females) that were said at the meeting in an upper chamber; a. v. fr.—בני ע' 
<italic>sons of heaven, those enjoying the Divine Presence in the hereafter</italic>. Succ. 45
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 97
<sup>b</sup>.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲלִיּוֹת, עֲלִיּיוֹת</plural-form>. B. Mets. 117
<sup>a</sup> שתי ע' זו וכ' two upper stories, one above the other; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>going up, rising</italic>, opp. ירידה; also 
<italic>flight of stairs</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. (in Chald. dict.) ע' קבילי עלאי ע' וירידה וכ' when I rented the upper story, I was prepared to go up, but to go up and go down again I was not prepared. Ib. חדא ע' קבילית עלי שתי עליות וכ' Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) I was prepared for one flight of stairs but not for two flights; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>going up to Jerusalem, pilgrimage</italic>. Pes. 8
<sup>b</sup> ע' שלא לשמה a pilgrimage not for its own sake; a. e.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as ab. B. Mets. l. c., v. supra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>elevation</italic> (to a higher dignity), 
<italic>promotion</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Hor. III, beg. 47
<sup>a</sup> עֲלִיָּיתוֹ וכ', v. יְרִידָה II. Gen. R. s. 68 ע' תהא להם they shall rise (to power). Keth. 61
<sup>a</sup> (play on בעלת בעל, Gen. XX, 3) בעלייתו של בעל וכ' the wife partakes of the comforts of the husband’s higher position, but is not bound to share the restrictions of his lower position, v. עָלָה; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>carrying up</italic>, esp. 
<italic>putting on the altar, offering</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Zeb. XIII, 1 חייב על הע' is punishable for the offering (outside of the Temple precincts). Ib. 3; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="P00770">עָלָה</xref>, c) 
<italic>neutralization, loss of identity</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Bicc. II, 65
<sup>a</sup> top מעשר אין לו ע' tithes (mixed up with secular food) are not neutralized.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—6)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the most valuable property</italic> (cmp. עִידִית).</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. I, 4, v. מְעוּלֶּה. Ib. 91
<sup>a</sup> רידיא ע' דמרה הוא the compensation for damages which is won by using the noxious ox for ploughing, is equal to a collection from the owner’s best possessions, (opp. to מגופו the indemnity collected from a sale of the animal). Ned. 56
<sup>a</sup> if one says, בית בביתי … מראהו ע' I sell thee a room in my house, he may show (assign) to him an upper chamber (v. supra); modified: מאי ע' מעולה וכ' 
<italic>ʿăliya</italic> means here (he must assign to him) the best room; Men. 108
<sup>b</sup>. Keth. l. c. 50
<sup>b</sup> ומאי ע' מעילוייא דאב and does 
<italic>ʿăliya</italic> mean ‘of the father’s best things’?; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00795">
<head-word>עֶלְיוֹן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> עָלָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>uppermost, highest; most high</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. X, 2 הע' the owner of the upper story, v. מַעֲזִיבָה. Y. Bicc. II, 64
<sup>d</sup> bot. (ref. to הקדש, Deut. XXVI, 13) הקודש הע' במשמע if refers to the sacred matter mentioned above (first-fruits, ib. 2, sq.). Maasr. V, 8 זרע לוף הע' the seed-
<pgbrk id="pg1083" />capsules on the tops of 
<italic>lof</italic> (v. לוֹף), expl. Y. ib. 52
<sup>a</sup> bot., v. סָלַל I; a. fr.—
<italic>Fem</italic>. עֶלְיוֹנָה. Tanḥ. Tsav 1 (play on עוֹלָה) שהיא ע' וכ' it is the highest of all sacrifices. B. Bath. 64
<sup>a</sup> דיוטא הע' the upper story. B. Mets. 77
<sup>b</sup> יד לוקח על הע' the buyer is at an advantage, has the choice between annulling and insisting on the bargain, opp. על התחתונה, v. יָד.—Lev. R. s. 24, beg. (ref. to Ps. XCII, 9) לעולם ידך בע' thy power is always uppermost, i.e. is always submitted to, whether thou blessest or punishest; Yalk. Ps. 843 על הע'; Y. Ber. IX, 14
<sup>b</sup> על הע', לע'; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֶלְיוֹנִים, עֶלְיוֹנִין;</plural-form> f. עֶלְיוֹנוֹת. Ib. 14
<sup>a</sup> top המים הע' the waters from above the earth; a. fr.—Esp. עליונים 
<italic>heavenly creatures, angels</italic>. Lev. R. s. 9 בראשון ברא מן הע' וכ' on the first he created heavenly and earthly things &c.; בראו מן הע' וכ' he created man so as to make him partake of the nature of the upper creatures and of that of the lower; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00804">
<head-word>עֲלִילָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>bringing about, causation</italic>,] 
<italic>dealing, government, disposition</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲלִילוֹת</plural-form>. Ex. R. s. 2, v. עָוַת.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="P00568">עִילָה</xref>) [
<italic>round about way</italic>,] 
<italic>circumvention, perverseness, insidiousness; pretext, false charge</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 101
<sup>b</sup> שלשה באו בע' three men (Biblical personages) came with indirectness (instead of praying in a straightforward manner). Gen. R. s. 93 מתחלה באת עלינו בע' from the start thou camest against us with insidiousness (trying to find charges against us); Tanḥ. Vayigg. 5; Yalk. Gen. 151. Esth. R. to III, 9 המן … בע' גדולה וכ' Haman, the wicked, came with great trickery against Israel (tempting them to sin). Ib. באו בע' וכ' they (the Israelites) came with a pretext, saying, let us go to sacrifice (Ex. V, 3). Pesik. R. s. 26 ראה היאך תמצא לו ע' וכ' see how thou canst find a charge against Jeremiah and be revenged on him; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. as ab. Ex. R. l. c., v. עָוַת</plural-form>. Num. R. s. 20 שלא ליתן לו ע' (not יתן) so as not to allow him any excuses.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00815">
<head-word>עָלַל</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> עוֹלֵל 
<italic>Pol. to bring about</italic>) 
<italic>to go about</italic>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (cmp. סוּר I ch.) 
<italic>to superintend, be busy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to VI, 10 … מלך ומסרו לאריס לַעֲלוֹל בו a King that had a vineyard and gave it in charge of a tenant to attend to it (ed. Wil. לעֹמול).—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. עָלוּל; f. עֲלוּלָה; 
<plural-form>pl. עֲלוּלִים, עֲלוּלִין; עֲלוּלוֹת</plural-form> [
<italic>brought about</italic>,] 
<italic>liable, likely</italic> (cmp. רָגִיל). Nidd. 7
<sup>b</sup> ע' לקבל טומאה likely to catch uncleanness; Tosef. Makhsh. II, 11.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (with ל־; cmp. סוּר I) 
<italic>to ascend, land, enter</italic>.</definition>

<sup>b</sup> top עד שיִתְעַלֵּם מעיניהם until he is left out of their sight. Y. Ber. IV, 8

<entry id="P00856">
<head-word>עָמַך</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to stand, stand up, rise; to remain, endure; to be ready</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. V, 1 אין עוֹמְדִין להתפלל וכ' you must not stand up (make ready) for prayer, &c., v. כּוֹבֶד. Ib. I, 2 שכן דרך … לַעֲמוֹד וכ' for princes generally rise at three hours. Ib. 3 (expl. ובקומך, Deut. VI, 7) בשעה שבני אדם עוֹמְדִים at the time when people get up (in the morning). Kidd. 71
<sup>a</sup> עוֹמֵד בחצי ימיו a middle-aged man. Y. Snh. VIII, 26
<sup>b</sup> ע' בדין stood before court. B. Mets. 47
<sup>b</sup> מי שאינו עומד בדיבורו who does not stand by (keep) his promise. Kil. IV, 4 העומד that part of the fence which is unimpaired, opp. פרוץ. Neg. I, 3, sq. העומד the leprous spot which remained in its place (Lev. XIII, 28). B. Bath. 60
<sup>b</sup> יכולין לעמוד בה, v. גְּזֵרָה. Ex. R. s. 2 בקש משה שיַעַמְדּוּ וכו' Moses prayed that from him should rise priests and kings; a. v. fr.—Esp. uses: ע' על 
<italic>a</italic>) 
<italic>to understand</italic>. Y. Shek. I, 45
<sup>d</sup>, v. אוֹפִי; a. e.—
<italic>b</italic>) 
<italic>to insist upon</italic>. Meg. 28
<sup>a</sup> לא עָמַדְתִּי על מדותי, v. מִדָּה. Kidd. l. c. מְעַמֵּד על מדותיו 
<italic>Pi.</italic> (Rashi מַעֲמִיד 
<italic>Hif.</italic>)—
<italic>c</italic>) 
<italic>to be reduced to</italic>. Y. Ber. II, 5
<sup>c</sup> ע' על חמשים it came down to fifty; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of liquids) 
<italic>to settle, become consistent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. 35
<sup>b</sup> חלב טהור עומד milk of a clean animal curdles (can be made into cheese or butter).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (of blades) 
<italic>to become dull</italic> (without being notched).</definition>
<notes> Bets. 28
<sup>b</sup> סכין שעָמְדָה מותר וכ' a slaughtering knife which has become dull may be sharpened on the Holy Day.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> עוֹמֵד ל־ 
<italic>standing ready, designated for</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 13
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. כל העומד לזרוק וכ' whatever is ready to be sprinkled, is considered as if it had been sprinkled. Keth. 51
<sup>a</sup> top; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition> ע' ב־ 
<italic>to resist</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to VII, 8 כל … לעמוד בזנות he who can resister the temptation of lust; כאילו עומד בשתיהן as if he resisted both; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶעֱמִיד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to stand, to place; to restore, preserve; to beget, produce</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. R. Hash. I, 57
<sup>b</sup> top הַעֲמִידוּ בימה put the dais up (to hold court). Tam. V, 6 היה מַעֲמִיד וכ' made the unclean priests stand in the eastern gate. Yeb. 62
<sup>b</sup> הם הם הֶעֱמִידוּ תורה וכ' it was they who preserved the law (tradition) in those days. Ab. I, 1 הַעֲמִידוּ תלמידים הרבה rear many scholars. Num. R. s. 14 ה' בנים begot children. Koh. R. to I, 4 מה היא עומדת מַעֲמֶדֶת what does 
<italic>ʿ</italic>
<italic>omadeth</italic> (ib.) mean? She (the earth) preserves, v. תַּפְקִיד. Gen. R. s. 90 שכל ארץ וארץ מעמדת פירותיה each ground preserves its own fruits (when put into the ground). Ib. דברים שהן מַעֲמִידִין substances which conserve, v. קִטְמִית; a. fr.—2) 
<italic>to change the standing of; to enlarge; to reduce</italic>. Meg. 15
<sup>b</sup> שתי אמות היה והֶעֱמִידוֹ על וכ' it was two cubits long, and he extended it to twelve. Macc. 24
<sup>a</sup> (of the 613 laws of the Torah) בא דוד והֶעֱמִידָן על וכ' David came and brought them down to eleven (Ps. XV); בא עמוס והעמידן על אחת Amos came and reduced them to one (Am. V, 4).—3) ה' (על) עצמו 
<italic>to contain, check one’s self</italic>. Snh. 72
<sup>a</sup> אין אדם מעמיד עצמו על ממונו no one will restrain himself from defending his property. Ib. 93
<sup>b</sup> מַעֲמִידִין על עצמם בשעה וכ' they restrained themselves when they had a human need.—4) (of liquids) 
<italic>to make consistent, curdle</italic>. Ab. Zar. II, 5 מעמידין אותן בקיבת נבלה they make the cheese by putting into the milk rennet from an animal not ritually slaughtered. Orl. <sup>b</sup> bot. לעולם יהא אדם ע' וכ' one should always be meek (patient) like Hillel, opp. קפדן impatient; (Ab. d’R. N. ch. XV עָנָו). Sabb. 31
<sup>a</sup> עי' הלל ינוחו וכ' O thou forbearing Hillel, blessings rest upon thy head; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עִנְוְתָנִין, עִנְוְו', עִינְ'</plural-form>. B. Mets. 84
<sup>b</sup> bot. שלשה ע' הן three persons are known for their humility. Ab. d’R. N. ch. VII בזמן … ענוותן ובני ביתו ע' וכ' when a man is kind (to strangers), and his household kind &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup> sq. תא חזי מאי איכא בין תקיפי לע' בתראי … (Ms. M. לענותאי) come and see the difference between the rigorous rulers of former days and the mild of these latter days.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00967">
<head-word>עִנְוְתָנוּת</head-word>
<head-word>עִנְוְו'</head-word>
<head-word>עִינְ'</head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>humility, patience, condescension</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> כל מקום שאתה מוצא גדולתו … אתה מוצא עִנְוְותָנוּתוֹ wherever (in the Scriptures) you find a description of the greatness of the Lord, you also find a description of his condescension (towards the lowly). Sabb. 31
<sup>a</sup> עינותנותו של וכ' Hillel’s patience brought us under the wings of the Divine Presence (caused us to embrace the Jewish religion); Ab. d’R. N. ch. XV עִנְיְתָנוּתְךָ הביאני וכ' (read: הביאתני) thy patience brought me &c. Gen. R. s. 74; Pesik. Shimʿu, p. 116
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. קפדנותן … ולא עִנְוְתָנוּתָן של בנים rather the angry mood of the fathers (Jacob) than the patience of the sons (David); a. fr.—Snh. 19
<sup>b</sup>, sq., v. תּוֹקֶף.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00970">
<head-word>עני</head-word>
<head-word>עָנָה</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to turn, come out in turn</italic>,] 
<italic>to begin to speak; to respond; to speak</italic> or 
<italic>sing in chorus; to answer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tem. 16
<sup>a</sup> ע̇תנ̇יא̇ל̇ שעֲנָאו̇ א̇ל̇ he was surnamed Othniel, because God answered his prayer (ref. to I Chr. IV, 10). Y. Sot. V, 20
<sup>c</sup> top והן עוֹנִין אחריו על כל דבר ודבר and they (the class) repeat each sentence after him; משה … והן עונין אחריו אשירה Moses said, I will sing &c., and they repeated in chorus, I will sing &c. Ib. משה אמר עזי והן עונין וכ' Moses said, My strength &c., and they responded, I will sing &c. Tosef. ib. VI, 2 ועונין על כל עינין ועינין and they (the class) repeat each sentence. Ib. 3 ועונין אחריו עינין ראשון and they (the people) always repeated the first sentence (as refrain). Succ. 38
<sup>b</sup> מצוה לַעֲנוֹת הללויה it is proper to say in response Halleluiah. M. Kat. III, 9 כולן עוֹנוֹת כאחת all start the dirge at once; אחת מדברת וכולן עונות אחריה one speaks, and all repeat in chorus after her, v. עִינּוּי I. Ber. 47
<sup>a</sup> עד שיכלה אמן מפי העוֹנִים until the Amen of the responding company is finished. Pes. 36
<sup>a</sup> לחם שעונין וכ', v. עוֹנִי. Y. Succ. III, 54
<sup>a</sup> top אם בירכך גוי עֲנֵה אחריו אמן if a gentile blesses thee, say after him Amen; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נַעֲנֶה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be answered, to have one’s prayer granted</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 30
<sup>a</sup> וכשאמר זכור … מיד נ' but when he said, Remember &c. (Ex. XXXII, 13), his prayer was at once granted. R. Hash. 18
<sup>a</sup> זה התפלל ונ' וכ' one prays and is heard, another prays and is not heard; Koh. R. to IX, 11, v. פָּגַע. Gen. R. s. 60 [read:] שלשה הם שנַעֲנוּ במענה פיהם three persons (mentioned in the Scriptures) were answered as soon as they had uttered their prayer; Yalk. ib. 108; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be called upon to speak; to answer, to deliver an opinion</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 40
<sup>b</sup> נ' ר"ט ואמר וכ' R. Ṭ. (being asked his opinion) answered saying &c.; נַעֲנוּ כולם ואמרו וכ' all of them in turn answered saying &c.; Sifré Deut. 41. M. Kat. 28
<sup>b</sup> (at a mourner’s house); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to be made to respond Amen</italic>,] 
<italic>to be sworn; to promise allegiance</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Dem. II, 23
<sup>a</sup> top הוא נ' לחבורה … נַעֲנִין לו he (the head of the house) promises allegiance to the order (v. חֲבֵרוּת), and the members of his house make the promise to him.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עִינָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to speak</italic> or 
<italic>sing in chorus</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to lament</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. III, 9, מְעַנּוֹת, v. עִינּוּי I.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="P00971">
<head-word>עֲנֵי</head-word>
<head-word>עֲנָא</head-word>
<head-word>(עֲנָה)</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. II Esth. VI, 10. Targ. I Kings XII, 7.—Targ. Ps. XXXIV, 5 (Ms. עַנְיָינִי). Ib. CII, 3; a. fr.—Y. Succ. III, 54
<sup>a</sup> top מה נַעְנֵי what shall we say in response? Ib. ר' יונה ע' הכין והכין R. J. responded, so be it, and so be it. Ab. Zar. 18
<sup>a</sup> bot. אימא אלהא דמאיר עֲנֵנִי say, O God of Meïr, hear me; a. fr.—[Men. 17
<sup>a</sup> עני מרי, v. 
<xref rid="unknown">עֲנֵי II</xref>.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עַנֵּי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to speak</italic> or 
<italic>sing in chorus; to respond</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Ex. XV, 21. Targ. II Esth. VI, 11.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְעַנֵּי, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְעֲנֵי, אִיעֲנֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be answered</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Ex. XIX, 19. Targ. Prov. XXI, 13 נתעני ed. Wil. (ed. Lag. נַעֲנוֹי will answer him; h. text יֵעָנֶה).—</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>*2)</number>
<definition> (euphem.) 
<italic>to be gratified, be eased</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shebi. III, 34
<sup>c</sup> bot. ההן דאזיל ולא מִתְעַנֵּי … he who went out to ease his bowels without success; [perhaps to be read מתפני, v. פְּנֵי?]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="P00972">
<head-word>עני</head-word>
<head-word>עָנָה</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. אָנָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to press, be pressed; to be detained</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עִינָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to detain, postpone</italic>, esp. ע' דין 
<italic>to delay execution of capital judgment</italic> (which should take place on the day of sentence).</definition>
<notes> Snh. XI, 4 (89
<sup>a</sup>) אין מְעַנִּין את דינו של וכ' we must not put off his execution (opp. to the opinion משמרין אותו). Ib. 35
<sup>a</sup> וליגמריה … נמצא אתה מְעַנֶּה את דינו shall we pass sentence on Friday and put him to death on Sunday? In such a case you would postpone his execution (against the law); v. עִינּוּי II.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause privation; to cause to fast</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 77
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to ויענה, Gen. XXXIV, 2) התם שעִינָּהּ מביאות וכ' this may be interpreted, that he deprived her of other connections. Ib. VIII, 4 התינוקות אין מענין אותן וכ' we must not let children fast on the Day of Atonement, v. חָנַךְ; a. e.—
<italic>Part. pass.</italic> מְעוּנֶּה 
<italic>fasting</italic>. Tosef. Taan. II, 7; Erub. 41
<sup>a</sup> כדי שלא יכנס לשבת כשהוא מע' that he may not begin the Sabbath fasting; Tanḥ. B’resh. 2.–</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to afflict, oppress, wrong</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. Mishp., s. 18 (ref. to Ex. XXII, 22) עד שיְעַנֶּה וישנה until he practices oppression repeatedly; a. e.—Part. pass. מְעוּנֶּה; 
<plural-form>pl. מְעוּנִּין</plural-form>. Yeb. 48
<sup>b</sup> מפני מה גרים בזמן הזה מע' וכ' why are the proselytes of our days afflicted and subject to suffering?</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to violate, outrage</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 9 (ref. to Mic. II, 9) שהיו מְעַנִּים נשי וכ' they violated married women and caused them to be forbidden to their husbands. Lev. R. s. 19; a. fr.—Mekh. l. c.; Yalk. Ex. 349 אם כשלא תְעַנּוּן את הדין וכ' if your wives will be spared from widowhood and your children from bereavement, because you do not violate justice, how much more, when you execute justice.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נַעֲנֶה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be afflicted, oppressed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. l. c. אלמנה … שדרכן לֵעָנוֹת בהן וכ' widows and orphans who are liable to be oppressed,—of them the text speaks (Ex. XXII, 21); Yalk. l. c. שדרכן לֵיעָנוֹת (not שדרכו).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to humble one’s self; to submit to a person’s discretion, beg pardon</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 28
<sup>a</sup> נַעֲנֵיתִי לך מחול לי I submit myself to thee, forgive me. Pesik. R. s. 38 נעניתי לו I beg his pardon. Yoma 22
<sup>b</sup> נעניתי לכם עצמות וכ' I beg your pardon, bones of Saul!; Yalk. Sam. 117 נעניתי לך שאול וכ'. Keth. 67
<sup>b</sup> נעניתי לך קום אכול I beg of thee, get up and eat. Tosef. Ohol. V, 12 נמיתי לכם עצמות וכ' ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. נמתי, read נעניתי) I beg your pardon, bones of &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְעַנֶּה, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְעַנֶּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be afflicted, suffer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Deut. 130 שנִתְעַנּוּ, v. עִינּוּי II.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to afflict one’s self, to fast</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 8
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Lev. XXIII, 32) וכי בתשעה מִתְעַנִּין do men fast on the ninth (of Tishri)? R. Hash. 18
<sup>b</sup> אין גזרת … רצו מתענין when there is no political persecution, but no peace, those who wish may fast &c. Erub. 41
<sup>a</sup> והִתְעַנִּינוּ בו ולא וכ' we fasted, but not to the end of the day; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶעֱנִי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of עָנִי) 
<italic>to become poor</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. VI, 6. Ber. 33
<sup>a</sup> חזרו והֶעֱנוּ when they (the Jews) became poor again. Meïl. 17
<sup>a</sup> מי שיש לו אויב יַעֲנִי או יעשיר if one has an enemy, does one wish him to be poor or rich?; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="P00973">
<head-word>עֲנֵי</head-word>
<head-word>עֲנָא</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עַנֵּי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to tarry, be detained, late</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sot. I, 16
<sup>d</sup> bot. חד זמן ע' דריש once he (R. Meïr) was long in preaching (preached to a late hour, or came late); Num. R. s. 9 אִיעַנֵּי דרשה (
<italic>Ithpa.</italic>, read דָּרוֹשָׁה or דָּרְשָׁא); Lev. R. s. 9 תנתא מדרשא (corr. acc.). Y. Bicc. III, 65
<sup>c</sup> bot. חד זמן ע' מיסק (not מסיק) once he was late in coming; (Keth. 62
<sup>b</sup> משכתיה שמעתא); a. e.—עַנִּי מרי be slow, my lord (a respectful form of interrupting and introducing an objection or correction). Men. 17
<sup>a</sup> ע' מ' משמיה דרב וכ' beg pardon, sir; (do you mean to say) ‘in the name of Rab?’ Said he, yes. Ib. 81
<sup>a</sup> ע' מ' ארבעין וכ' beg pardon, he deserves forty lashes (for exchanging sacrifices), and yet his act is legal?; Snh. 26
<sup>b</sup> ע' מ' ארבעין … וכשר he deserves forty lashes, and yet his testimony is admissible? B. Kam. 49
<sup>b</sup> ע' מורי וכ'; [Rashi interprets: 
<italic>give answer</italic>, my lord, v. עֲנֵי I].</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to afflict, oppress</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Ex. XXII, 21, sq. Ib. I, 12 מְעַנַּן (Y. מְעַנְיַין); a. e.—Part. pass. מְעַנֵּי; 
<plural-form>pl. מְעַנָּן</plural-form>. Targ. Is. LIII, 4.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to violate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Deut. XXII, 24 (ed. Amst. עָנֵי, corr. acc.); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (with, or sub. נפשא) 
<italic>to afflict one’s self, fast</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Lam. III, 33 (ed. Amst. עָנֵי). Targ. Lev. XVI, 31; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab. Tanḥ. B’resh. 2 בשבת גופא לא מע' he does not fast on the Sabbath itself.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְעַנֵּי, אִיעַנֵּי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be delayed</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Num. R. s. 9, v. supra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be afflicted, suffer; to fast</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. I Kings II, 26. Targ. Zech. VII, 5; a. e.—Y. Ber. III, 6
<sup>b</sup> top; Y. Naz. VII, 56
<sup>a</sup> bot. בעי מזקפוניה ואשכחוניה איע' they wanted to help him up, but found that he was suffering; Koh. R. to VII, 2 (not איע' בדבורא).—4) 
<italic>to be violated</italic>. Targ. Lam. V, 11.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיעֲנִי</binyan-form>

<sense>

<entry id="P00976">
<head-word>עָנִי</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="P00952"> עָנָה II)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>afflicted, humble</italic>,] 
<italic>poor</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. I, 1, sq., v. בַּיִת.—מעשר ע', v. מַעֲשֵׂר.—Ned. 64
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. ארבעה ע' סומא וכ' … four classes of people are as if dead, the poor man, the blind &c. Ib. 41

<sup>b</sup>; Keth. 106
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. אין ע' במקום עשירות there must be no stint where there is wealth, i.e. you must not be small in large affairs. Ex. <pgbrk id="pg1095" />באניות, Deut. XXVIII, 68) בע' ממעשים טובים in thy want of good deeds.—Y. Kidd. III, 64
<sup>b</sup> top בעֲנִיּוּתֵינוּ צריכה וכ' according to our poverty (of mind), she requires a letter of divorce from him.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
